`boss-end-round.step.gz` is quiddity-rust v0.2.5 (6110b4c8)'s
`tests/fixtures/boss_end_round.step.gz`, unchanged. It is a 20 mm boss on a 4 mm
supporting plate, with an R1.5 convex end round. The cylindrical wall ends at
22.5 mm; the boss ends at 24 mm. Shared under quiddity-rust's
[Apache-2.0 licence](https://github.com/pzfreo/quiddity/blob/v0.2.5/LICENSE). It checks that the drawing uses the complete boss height and retains
the independent radius callout (quiddity-rust#134).
